sentences: The cited work studies how algebraic formulas can be transformed into formulas of smaller depth.
The retained question asks whether a containment arising in that analysis is strict.
A strict inclusion would mean that one of the compared resource regimes computes polynomial families unavailable to the other.
This matters because simulation upper bounds can conceal a real gain from additional depth or formula structure.
The excerpt omits both classes in the inclusion, so it supports this research direction but does not justify naming a particular hierarchy separation or quantitative lower bound.
